fields.Name: W1 -> S3.2
fields.Description: Gate G1.11 (phase 1, dataset W1, criterion S3.2): for 20 sampled scored W1-signal s42 rows, every feature value resolves to its source, source version and computed-at, 20 of 20. The scored rows must be the sampled rows, each row must carry one provenance entry per feature (5 x 20 = 100 values) covering every matrix column, and each entry must name its own row: the row's key, its stored PersonID as the aggregate owner and its decision day computed by the unit's rule. It fails when a provenance entry lacks a usable computedAt (the recorded mutation has the assembler write an empty computedAt), when a value does not re-derive from its source, or when a row's provenance does not name that row.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: 20 of 20 sampled scored W1 rows resolve all 100 feature values to their source, source version and computed-at, each bound to its own row, with every matrix column covered.
